name: init
description: Create a new Cloudflare project or set up an existing one

arguments.name: directory
arguments.description: Directory to initialize; created when missing (prompts when omitted; use . for the current directory)

options.name: install
options.description: Install dependencies after creating a new project (use --no-install to skip)

options.name: package-manager
options.description: Package manager for a new project (prompts when interactive)

options.name: dry-run
options.description: Parse arguments and show the command without executing it
